svg.title: How many cosignatures stop a fork
svg.desc: With n = 5 witnesses, f compromised and a client requiring k cosignatures: two conflicting checkpoints can both reach k exactly when 2k is at most n + f. Any two sets of k witnesses overlap in at least 2k - n witnesses; if that exceeds f, an honest witness is in both and would have refused one.

text.tspan: two quorums of k overlap in at least 2k - n witnesses.
if 2k - n > f, the overlap holds an honest witness, who signs only one branch.
but k = n means one witness offline blocks every client: pick k with spare.
